messages:
zach: Quick sync — two pilot customers (OptiLab, PaxCare) pushed back on GA scope. They want per-route cost visibility and better error→trace linking before full rollout. I think we should carve a v1 that focuses on high-impact, low-effort pieces and defer the expensive pieces. Proposal below. 

linh: +1 to cutting scope. can you spell v1 vs v2 concretely? also we need launch criteria (SLOs/metrics) before committing. :eyes:

zach: Proposed split: 
- v1 (MVP): dashboard: top-level cost summary + top 10 tenants by spend; error analytics: aggregated error counts with a trace-link button that opens the trace; lightweight tracing hook that adds a redwood.request_id span tag. sampling default 1% but configurable per-tenant.
- v2: per-route token-level breakdown, full-trace retention for 30d for enterprise, UI cost explorer, advanced anomaly detection.

marie: From the customer success calls, per-route token breakouts are the ask that customers mention first. But they said they'd accept a CSV export for now if the dashboard shows the same numbers. Can we promise an export API for v1?

alex_b: CSV export is feasible. engineering notes:
```
- tracing hook: inject tag at ingress and annotate spans when runtime does batching/serve
- minimal trace link: store trace_id in metrics log and surface link into UI (requires minor datastore add)
- sampling: start 1%, allow tenant override via config in dedicated/private
```
Cost estimate: ~2.5 dev-weeks for the tracing + link, ~1.5 dev-weeks for dashboard and CSV export, infra changes ~1 week for metrics retention indexing.

ryan: For launch criteria we should gate on: 
- accuracy: cost numbers within 5% vs billing for top-10 accounts (pass)
- perf: dashboard load <500ms for summary queries under normal load
- reliability: trace-link success >= 95% for sampled traces
- rollout: canary to 5 customers then 50 then GA over 2 weeks

linh: Add acceptance tests: a small prompt set that reproduces token billing for a tenant (for the 5% accuracy check), and an e2e that clicks trace-link and validates the trace open. Also telemetry: ensure we emit feature usage (how many downloads of CSV, how many trace-link clicks).

product-bot: Created ticket RD-51234: "console: telemetry MVP (cost summary + trace-link + CSV export)" assigned to @alex_b, due 2026-04-15. :robot_face:

zach: Decision check: ship v1 = dashboard summary + CSV export + trace-link + minimal tracing hook + sampling default 1%. Defer per-route token breakdown and extended retention to v2. Action items:
- alex_b: break down RD-51234 into sub-tasks + estimates (by EOD)
- linh: draft acceptance test spec + sampling tuning experiment (by Tue)
- marie: notify OptiLab/PaxCare that we have a CSV interim and ask for early canary (by Mon)
- ryan: draft canary rollout plan & metrics (by Wed)

marie: ok will send emails and set up canary calls. :+1:

alex_b: will split tasks and comment on RD-51234 shortly.

zach: thanks — keeping scope tight will help us hit GA without letting cost explode. follow-up in product sync tomorrow. :rocket:
